verdict: Ads have been paused since September 15; four milestones remain overdue.
narrative: Paid ads stopped running on September 15, so the 6 leads and $180.80 in spend shown this period all came from the first 8 days of the window — the last 20 days produced zero paid leads. Your Google Business Profile has held steady organically, averaging roughly 5 actions per day without any paid support, which is a positive sign. Four agreed deliverables — phone-match attribution, contact cleanup, the reporting dashboard, and the August scoreboard — remain unresolved, and until those are in place the lead numbers cannot be fully trusted. Reconciling the lead count and completing those milestones is the immediate priority before ads resume.
